mapper.select: SELECT album_info.id albumId, MAX(IF(stat_type = '0401', stat_num, 0)) AS playStatNum, MAX(IF(stat_type = '0402', stat_num, 0)) AS subscribeStatNum, MAX(IF(stat_type = '0403', stat_num, 0)) AS buyStatNum, MAX(IF(stat_type = '0404', stat_num, 0)) AS commentStatNum FROM album_info JOIN album_stat ON album_info.id = album_stat.album_id WHERE album_info.id = #{id};

select max(if(stat_type='0701',stat_num,0)) playStatNum , max(if(stat_type='0702',stat_num,0)) subscribeStatNum , max(if(stat_type='0703',stat_num,0)) buyStatNum, max(if(stat_type='0704',stat_num,0)) commentStatNum from track_stat where track_id = #{trackId};
